text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アラゴの将として王に仕えていたこの俺が、
今や侵略者だ。
text.official_en:
At one point, I served Arago's king as a general.
Now I return as an invader.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、この道こそが……
正しい世界に続くものだと信じている。
text.official_en:
But what else is there to do? This is how we create a
just world.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
困難な行軍、寡兵での攻め手。
だが敗北するような心地は毛ほどもしない。
text.official_en:
A difficult march and an offensive with a small force.
Yet no part of me feels we are at risk of defeat.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これも、頼もしき戦士たちが
我が陣営に集ってくれた故だろう。
text.official_en:
I suspect this is because redoubtable warriors have
rallied to my side.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの大剣闘祭が繋いだ縁なのか……
あるいは……
text.official_en:
It may be the connections we forged during the
Heroic Games. Or perhaps...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
もう！　おじいさまったら。
急に手紙を寄こしてきたと思ったら……！
text.official_en:
I got a letter from my grandpa. At first, I thought he
was checking in to see how I'm doing...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
敵兵の動向把握のやり方や逃げ道の確保について
みっちり書かれてるだけだったわ。
text.official_en:
What he'd actually written me was a detailed method
for grasping enemy movement and escape routes.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
どれもあたしが生き残るための方法ばかり。
すごく心配してくれているのが伝わるけれど……
text.official_en:
I'll admit, it is clear that he's sharing those ideas
because he's worried about me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
これじゃあ、おじいさまご自身の近況が
わからないじゃないの！
text.official_en:
But he could have at least offered a sentence or two
about how he's getting on!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
父さんはぼくが帝都に行くのを反対してたけど、
今はどうしてるんだろう。
text.official_en:
My dad wasn't happy with the idea of me going to
Dagsion. I wonder how he's doing...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ぼくの命が今もあるのは、
父さんが教えてくれた弓のおかげなんだ。
text.official_en:
I'm only still alive because he taught me how to use
a bow.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
絶対に生きて帰って、
いつかちゃんと、お礼を言わないと……
text.official_en:
As soon as I'm home again, I'm going to tell him
thank you for saving my life.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ノーラ……ツェザリ……
お腹空かしていないかしら。心配だわ……
text.official_en:
I keep thinking about Noah and Cezarie.
I worry they're hungry.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ご飯を食べる度に、顔を思い出しちゃう。
だから今も頑張れているんだけどね。
text.official_en:
It happens every time I eat. I can see their faces, and
I think about how they're why I'm doing this.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このまま首尾良く行けば、確実に
グラン・アラゴンが戦場になるだろうね。
text.official_en:
If all goes well, Grand Aragon's going to become a
battlefield.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけど、そこでどれだけの血が流れるのかは、
ボクたち次第ってわけさ。ヒヒヒッ！
text.official_en:
How much blood gets soaked into the ground—
that's up to us. Heh heh!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ま……ボクは、ベルトランがどんな道を往こうと
嗤ってついていくだけさ。
text.official_en:
No matter where the king goes, I follow, with a
smile on my face.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ブレザラントが昔、俺っちのいたケトール族と
いろいろあったってのは知ってる。
text.official_en:
My tribe, the Chetaur, had some kinda dustup
with Brezarant.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
「モンス動乱」のときにそそのかされて、
その頃の王様に歯向かったとかなんとか……
text.official_en:
During the Mons Uprising, we got pulled
into rebelling against the king.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それをどう思うかしつこく聞いてくる奴がいてよ。
俺っちはこう言い返してやったぜ。
text.official_en:
Been getting a LOT of questions about that time
from a certain someone. Know what I said?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
兄貴と俺っちはな、大昔のしがらみなんかより、
ずっと固え絆で結ばれてんだ！　……ってな。
text.official_en:
"That's old hat. What my brother and me got going—
that's new hat!"

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この作戦……吉と出るか、凶と出るか。
まだ見定めるのは早いが……
text.official_en:
Will this plan bring us good fortune or ill? It's too
early to tell.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ベルトランの瞳に宿っていたのは、
揺るぎのない、まさに理想を追う王の決意だった……
text.official_en: But I see a king confident in his ideals.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……ならば、私に異論はない。
兵らをまとめ、共に行くのみ。
text.official_en:
Given that, I will make no objections, but merely
gather soldiers and charge into battle.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ああ……いいね。
極地を踏み越え、ついにベルトランは往くんだ。
text.official_en:
A magnificent story unfolds! A king crossing the
ultimate threshold, and now charging forth.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
己の生まれ育った地へ。愛する女の元へ。
宿敵にして親友だった男の統べる国へ……
text.official_en:
Trodding again in the land where he was born and
raised, toward the woman he loves.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
果たしてどんな結末を迎えるのか……
見届けさせてもらおう。
text.official_en:
A country ruled by his former friend—now his most
hated adversary. What awaits? We shall see!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ギルキルス王は随分と悪名高い様子、
しかし今なお玉座に収まっているそうですね。
text.official_en:
King Gilchris seems to be quite notorious, and yet it
appears that the throne remains in his grasp.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いくら獣といえど、群れの長に相応しくない者は
その座から降ろされてしまうのが自然です。
text.official_en:
Beast or no, it is only natural that a leader unfit for
the role be ousted.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そうしないのは余程臆病者が揃っているか……
女神の眷属が糸を引いているかでしょうな。
text.official_en:
Yet it is not so. Either his land is rife with cowardice,
or the children of the goddess prop him up.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争……
どんどん激しくなるね……
text.official_en:
As the war drags on, the fighting is getting more and
more intense.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
やっぱり、あたいはダーリンみたいには
戦いが好きになれないな。
text.official_en: I don't enjoy it the way Sweetie does.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大剣闘祭ぐらいがちょうどいいよ。
あれは願いを聞いてもらうための戦いだしさ。
text.official_en:
The Heroic Games made sense to me, because it was
all to get your wish granted.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私は日陰に咲く花が好きです。
誰にも知られずひっそりと咲く花が。
text.official_en:
I've always loved flowers that bloom in the shade...
Flowers that bloom quietly, unnoticed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
愛でられることはありませんが
最期まで静かに生き続けていられる……
text.official_en:
They may go unloved, but they're happy for their
entire lives up until the end.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そんな様に惹かれるのでしょうね。
生きる上で愛される必要など……ありませんから。
text.official_en:
We're similar in that way. I... I don't need to be
loved...to live.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
………………
正直いまだに信じられねえな。
text.official_en: Honestly, I still can't believe it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝が竜になって襲って来たと思ったら、
星が降ってくるたあな。
text.official_en:
First, Emperor Dagda turns into a dragon and attacks
us, then the stars start falling out of the sky!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ、結局こうして生きてるんだし、
今更逃げようなんざ思わねえけどよ。
text.official_en:
Hard to believe I'm even breathing right now.
Even more reason to see this through.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こんなに劇的な展開になるなんて……！
竜になって襲い来る神、そこへ落ちる星……！
text.official_en:
I never expected anything like this! First, a dragon
attacks us, then a star falls right on him!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争中じゃなかったら、
今すぐ武器を捨ててすごい戦記物を書くのに！
text.official_en:
If I wasn't busy fighting for my life, I might just write
this into a new story!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
絶対に死んじゃ駄目よルル！
あなたは将来大傑作を書くんだから！
text.official_en:
But if I want to write anything ever again, I have to
make sure I don't die first!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
神威大帝様は竜となり、多くの方を
死に追いやってしまわれました……
text.official_en:
The Divine Emperor turned into a dragon and killed
so many...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグザ様は、本気で私たちを
滅ぼすおつもりなのですね……
text.official_en: It seems he truly intends to wipe us all out...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それならば構いません……！
私は漸くあの方のお命を奪う覚悟が決まりました。
text.official_en:
If that's the case, then fine. I'll use my strength
to help end him.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
作戦の内容がどうあれ……
俺は従うのみだ。
text.official_en: Whatever the plan is, I'll be sure to follow it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦い続けた先で……また会えるだろうか……
オルヘル……
text.official_en:
I wonder if we'll meet again after this battle,
Orchel...
text.real_en:
I wonder if we'll meet again after this battle,
Orhel...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アラゴ王国のギルキルス王は、
歯向かう奴に容赦ねえって話だろ……
text.official_en:
They say King Gilchris of Arago shows no mercy
to those who stand up to him.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
危ねえ砂漠を越えて、
そっからそんな王様と戦うってことか……
text.official_en: But we've crossed the desert to fight him.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
きついだろうけど……覚悟は決まってる。
途中で脱落とか、してたまるかよ。
text.official_en:
It's going to be tough, but I'm ready for what's
next. There's no way I'll give up now!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争とはいつの時代も酷いものだ。
絶えず血と涙が流れ、弱き者から死んでいく。
text.official_en:
No matter the era, war is a terrible thing. Blood
flows, tears gush, and the weak are first to die.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
故に私は何としてもやめさせたいのだ。
一介の旅人の発言にしては傲慢かもしれんがね。
text.official_en:
That's why I'm determined to put an end to this war.
A bold ambition for a mere traveler, I suppose.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
「光の杭」……あれが、人の造った物なの？
クレール様の鍛えるアークとは、まるで違う。
text.official_en:
Hmm... Javelins of light... Is that something the
humans made? It's not like any of Credna's Arcs.
text.real_en:
Hmm... Javelins of light... Is that something the
humans made? It's not like any of Claire-sama's Arcs.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
武器というよりも……ただ何もかもを、
破壊する存在。ニネには、そう感じられる。
text.official_en:
I sensed it was not a weapon in spirit, however...
more an entity that hungered for destruction.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
口惜しや……陛下の軍師はワタクシだというのに……
ベルトラン……よもやあのような策を……
text.official_en:
How frustrating... I am Her Majesty's tactician,
yet it is Bertrand who devised our stratagem.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アラゴ主力の裏をかいた、型破りの行軍……
よもや、そのような策があろうとは……！
text.official_en:
I had never considered a route that bypasses
Arago's main force entirely.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが……その奇策に惹かれたのも事実よ。
アラゴ主力の裏をかいた、型破りの行軍……
text.official_en:
But his outlandish scheme does have a certain
appeal. A means of bypassing Arago's main force...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが……その奇策に惹かれたのも事実。
軍師として、口惜しい限りよ……
text.official_en:
But Bertrand's outlandish scheme does have a certain
appeal, even to an orthodox tactician like me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
陛下も賛同しているのだ。かくなる上は、
ワタクシも市街での戦術を献策し、お役に立たねば！
text.official_en:
And since Your Majesty agrees, I must draw up plans
at once for urban warfare!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
かくなる上は、ワタクシも道中有効な戦術を
献策し、せめてもの役に立たねばな……
text.official_en:
I must make up for it by devising my own
improvements to the plan as we go.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ガッハッハッハ！
３０００人で、アラゴ王国と喧嘩とはなー！
text.official_en:
Baw haw haw! We're gonna take on Arago with our
three thousand soldiers!

text.jp:
向こうにいた騎士、その辺のガキに
自分の飯を分け与えてたな……信じらんねえ。
text.official_en:
There was a knight around here sharing his
grub with kids. Unbelievable!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ん？　いや、ああやって恩を売っておいて、
後で五倍にして返させるつもりなのか……？
text.official_en:
Hmm... But maybe that knight was really tryin'
to get paid back five times over!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ベルトランの野郎がブレザラント王に
なってるの、いまだに信じらんねえな……
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
最初に会った時、奴に足を
なめさせてやろうとしたんだよな。
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
上手くいきゃあ「王に足をなめさせた男」って
マジーデ様にいっそう箔がついたのによ。チッ。
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争の最中は駆け出しの時分を思い出すな。
上からの理不尽な叱咤やいじめに耐えたもんだわい。
text.official_en:
Being at war reminds me of my early days as a
soldier. My superiors really bullied me!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
飯に泥をかけられて『戦場では泥水もすするのだ。
食え。裸で訓練を受けたくなければ食え』とか……
text.official_en:
They'd throw mud in my food and make me eat it,
or else they'd make my training way worse!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
偉大な者は得てして、辛苦を味わうものだが……
あの飯は砂利が多くて痛かったなあ。
text.official_en:
I know one must suffer hardship to rise to the
occasion...but I never got a taste for dirt.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
傭兵には稼ぎ時だけど……
早く戦争が終わってほしいわ……
text.official_en:
Good time for mercenaries to make a profit, but
still, I wish this war would end soon.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
人が死ぬのを見るのって、
味方だろうが敵だろうが嫌だもの……
text.official_en:
I hate watching anyone die, even my worst
enemies.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの呻き声や歪んだ顔……
うう……平和が、恋しいわ……
text.official_en:
Faces twisted in pain... Voices wailing in horror...
Ugh, I miss more peaceful times.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
少しは資金が貯まったね。
このまま順調に増えればいいんだけど……
text.official_en:
I saved up a little bit of money so far. But I need
to keep on making more, bit by bit.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦争が長引き過ぎれば、出てく金も増えるし、
平和になったら、稼ぎが減っちまう。
text.official_en:
The longer the war goes on, the more I could make.
When peace returns, I might make very little.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いい具合に終わってほしいが、
そうはいかないだろうね。
text.official_en: I hope this all ends well. But I doubt it will.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
以前のブーケパラスは餌が足りないと
不機嫌になったけど、最近はおとなしいわ。
text.official_en:
Bucephalus used to get quite ornery if he didn't
eat enough. But he's been well-behaved lately.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私もみんなも必死に我慢していると
わかってくれたみたいね。
text.official_en:
It's like he knows that I, and everyone else, are
struggling with this whole, desperate situation.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……早く終わらせて、
お腹一杯に食べさせてあげたいな……
text.official_en:
But I'd like for this all to end soon. I'd like for him
to eat his fill.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私がアウロラ様のバルカンでなかったなら……
宗主国軍としてこの戦争に参加していただろう。
text.official_en:
Were I not a vulkan in Aurora's temple, I would
most likely be fighting as part of the empire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
神命に従い、サラミス王国を焼き払うか……
あるいは連合軍の快進撃の前に斃れるか……
text.official_en:
Obeying the divine command would involve either
razing Saramis or dying on the battlefield.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……私は、アウロラ様に救われている。
そのような苦悩の道を歩まずに済んでいるのだから。
text.official_en: Aurora saved me from walking that path of suffering.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
昔なら戦争のどさくさに紛れて
商船を襲いまくってたところだな……
text.official_en:
I'd done my fair share of taking advantage of war.
I used to attack merchant ships in the chaos.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
殺した奴の亡霊が見えるようにならなきゃ、
港で適当なのを奪って大暴れしてただろうに……
text.official_en:
I'd love to steal a ship and get back to it...if I
didn't keep seeing the ghosts of those I've killed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
盗ったところで俺の船に比べりゃ落ちるだろうがな。
ぐす、かわいそうな俺のかわい子ちゃん……ずび……
text.official_en:
But no ship could compare to that beauty I used to
captain. Ah, that poor ship...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミスの王が砂漠を越えるというならば、
ハル・ハリの戦士にできぬ道理はない。
text.official_en:
If the queen of Saramis says we will cross the desert,
then the Har Hali warriors will not shrink from it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
過酷な旅路となろうが……自然を読み、
共に生きるのが森の部族。成し遂げてみせようぞ。
text.official_en:
The forest peoples are accustomed to living off the
land. We will rise to this occasion.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……まさか、この俺が祖国を裏切り
こんなところで生き恥を晒すことになるとはな。
text.official_en:
Here I am! A traitor to my homeland, living here
in disgrace.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そればかりか、これからその祖国に
攻め入ろうというのだから、皮肉なものだよ。
text.official_en:
And now I am readying to join an attack on my
country of origin.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いや……これもまた、
実に俺らしい生き方なのかもしれないな。
text.official_en:
Then again, maybe... Maybe this is what I was
meant to do all along.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……まあ、流石の私も、
今回ばかりは少し疲れたよ。
text.official_en: That little stunt tired me out.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
「星」の制御ってのはね、恐らくお前たちの
想像以上の精神集中が必要になるのさ。
text.official_en:
Controlling a star requires more concentration than
you can probably imagine.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
少しでも気を抜くと、自分たちの頭の上に
あれが降ってくることになりかねないからね。
text.official_en:
If I let my focus slip even a little, it could have ended
up raining down on our own heads.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
正直なところを言うと……ここだけの話、
そんな事にならなくて心底ほっとしているよ。
text.official_en: Just between you and me, I'm relieved I managed it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
老母はザンジバル要塞の防衛に向かいました。
軍役に就いたことなど一度もありませんが……
text.official_en:
My elderly mother headed to Fort Zanbar to help
defend it. But she's never fought a day in her life!
text.real_en:
My elderly mother headed to Zanzibar Fortress to help
defend it. But she's never fought a day in her life!

text.jp:
国のため、家族のため、そして敬愛する陛下のため
何もせずにはいられない、と言っていました。
text.official_en:
She said she couldn't do nothing with her country,
her family, and her beloved queen on the line.

text.jp:
そんな母のこと、誇りに思います。
僕も負けてはいられません！
text.official_en:
I'm proud to have a mother like her. I'll do my best
so she can be proud of me too!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
砂漠を砂の海だって言う奴もいるが……
波の音がしないんで、そんな風に思えない。
text.official_en:
I guess deserts are kind of like a sea of sand. But I'll
still miss the sound of the waves.

text.jp:
やはり、俺達が本領を発揮できるのは海だ。
しかし今回は海戦がないようだ……無念。
text.official_en:
Whether it's fighting or fishing, the sea is where
I'm in my element. Too bad this isn't a naval war.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
置いてきたあの子は無事なのかしら……
この前、十歳になったばかりなのに……
text.official_en:
I wonder if that child I left behind is OK...she had
just turned 10 years old.

text.jp:
『私も母様のように戦います！』なんて……
こんな時手紙が書ければ、どれほど良かったか……
text.official_en:
She was saying stuff like "I want to fight, just like
my mom!" I wish I could at least get a letter to her.

text.jp:
できぬことを嘆いても仕方ありませんね。
せめて早く帰ってあげなければ……
text.official_en:
But wishing for the impossible gets you nowhere.
I've just got to return to her as soon as I can...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
山を越え谷を越え川を越え！
そして、砂漠をも越えるっ！！
text.official_en: Over mountains, valleys, rivers, and even the desert!

text.jp:
アーシラー族の気高き血が流れるこの身！
道中で力尽きるなど、断じてありえん！
text.official_en:
The noble blood of the Asherah flows in my veins.
I'll march on tirelessly to our destination!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
セオドラ陛下は血印を持たずとも、
ベルトラン王に匹敵する強さを持っておられる。
text.official_en:
Her Majesty doesn't have a bloodmark but can
match the king in strength.

text.jp:
こんな状況でなければ、
あの二人の戦いを見てみたかったですね。
text.official_en:
If things had gone differently between our nations,
I wonder how the fight would have gone.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
なんだかんだ、
サラミスの兵士と組んで動くのにも慣れてきたな。
text.official_en:
I'm not sure when it happened, but I've gotten used
to fighting side by side with the Saraminians.

text.jp:
妙な信仰を持つ不気味な連中だとビビッてたのが
嘘みてえだ。どいつも気のいい奴らだぜ。
text.official_en:
I was nervous they'd be a spooky crowd with weird
beliefs, but not really. They're pretty good folks.
